speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a significant medical history; to better understand your gait and limb ataxia, could you describe how these symptoms started and if they have progressed over time? Additionally, do you experience any other neurological symptoms like numbness, weakness, or changes in your vision?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Have you noticed any specific triggers for these symptoms, such as standing up quickly or performing specific tasks? Also, do you have a history of autoimmune conditions, diabetes, or chronic infections that might relate to this?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given your history of Crohn's disease treated with natalizumab, I am concerned about the risk of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Have you noticed any new visual disturbances, speech difficulties, or cognitive changes alongside your ataxia?

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast
REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain Axial and Coronal sequences
